independence.basis: Independent second-run operator task. Before freeze it inspected only public code, methodology, scaffold, attestations, and content-free identities; the sealed dataset was handled only as an opaque path and digest.

execution.two_build_reproducibility: PASS: 64/64 exact MCP bytes, response digests, tokenizer counts, and prompts identical across distinct ready index generations; maximum 1193/1200 cl100k
isolation_controls: Every participant item uses a new codex exec --ephemeral process; no resume or fork
Exactly one allowed input and direct -o output per item
Confidential --json log must match the exact agent_message-only event allowlist
Any process, tool-event, validation, or overwrite failure refuses the run without retry
limitations: OpenAI exposes no immutable backend model snapshot/build digest, so model behavior is not byte-reproducible.
Repository-writer malice remains outside the isolation guarantee described by the public threat model.

declaration: Before freeze, the independent second-run operator attests to the stated separation, candidate and corpus identities, fail-closed two-build requirement, stateless participant controls, no prior holdout participation, and no disclosure of holdout content to the root orchestration agent.
